title: The Stepping Stone River Crossing
statement:
An array A of non-negative integers represents river stepping stones. When standing at index i, you can jump at most A[i] steps forward.

Find the minimum number of jumps to reach the last index (N - 1) starting from index 0. If it is impossible to reach the end, print -1.
inputFormat:
First line: Integer N.
Second line: N space-separated integers.

sampleCases.explanation: Jump 1 step from 0 to 1, then 3 steps to the last index.
Jump from 0 to 1, then from 1 to 4.
